description: This file contains PHP classes and functions related to parsing and evaluating conditional expressions used in workflow triggers within the vtiger CRM project. It includes a parser, a conditional expression evaluator, and a custom exception class.

classes.name: VTConditionalExpression
classes.description: Class for parsing and evaluating conditional expressions based on provided data.

classes.name: VTConditionalParser
classes.description: Class responsible for lexical analysis and parsing of conditional expression strings.

classes.name: VTParseFailed
classes.description: Custom exception class used during parsing failures.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the parsed conditional expression against provided data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Initiates parsing of the expression string into a parse tree.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Tokenizes the input expression into an array of tokens.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the current token without advancing the position.

methods.name: nextToken
methods.description: Returns the current token and advances to the next.
